accounts.title: Circuit breaker state categories and execution admission
qualifications: Authored illustrative static interpretation at the pinned revision; not an observed execution or a result from the implemented PostCode investigator.
Default one-call recovery sampling with zero permitted counted failures.
Manual isolation, restored state, cancellation, competing external state changes and non-default sampling are outside this account.
Application-specific usage and business success are not established. Failure classification follows the configured policy.
Reentrant execution requests from event listeners during entry to Half-open are excluded; entry and slot reservation are treated as one admission step.

content.text: The policy governs admission of application-supplied work. Stored state categories and the progress of an individual execution are distinct. The identifying descriptions and admission account below address these two aspects under the stated scope.

content.name: Closed
content.description: A state category of the Circuit breaker policy kind in which ordinary supplied work is admitted.

content.name: Open
content.description: A state category withholding execution until the configured recovery delay makes an execution eligible to initiate a trial. Elapsed time alone does not change the stored state.

content.name: Half-open
content.description: A recovery state category of the Circuit breaker policy kind. Sampled work contributes to the decision to close or reopen the breaker; the category is not an individual execution or evidence of application health.

content.text: The application supplies work. The breaker controls admission and records outcomes according to its failure policy. State categories describe the policy, not the progress of a particular caller.
